chapterInfo.content:
34
Atamfoɔ nyinaa ho atemmusɛm
1Amanaman, montwe mpini mmɛtie,
na mo, nkurɔfoɔ, monwɛn mo aso.
Asase ne ne mayɛ ntie,
wiase ne deɛ ɛfiri mu ba nyinaa.
2Na AWURADE abohuro bɛba amanaman nyinaa so,
na abufuhyeɛ aba wɔn dɔm nyinaa so,
wadome wɔn de wɔn ama okum.
3 # Yes 14.19 Na wɔn atɔfoɔ no, wɔbɛto wɔn agu,
na wɔn afunu ayi hwa kankan,
na wɔn mogya atene wɔ mmepɔ so.
4 # Adi 6.13-14 Na ɔsoro asafo nyinaa bɛporɔ,
na wɔabobɔ ɔsoro sɛ nwoma,
na n’asafo nyinaa apo,
sɛdeɛ obobe so ahahan poɔ
anaasɛ borɔdɔma so deɛ poɔ no.
5 # Yer 49.7-22 Na m’afena anom amee wɔ soro;
hwɛ, ɛsiane ba Edom so,
ɛreba me nnome man no so abɛbu atɛn.
6Mogya ara nko adue AWURADE afena,
sradeɛ afɔre ho,
nnwammaa ne mpapo mogya,
adwennini sawa ho sradeɛ,
na AWURADE wɔ okum afɔdeɛ wɔ Bosra ne okunkɛseɛ wɔ Edom asase so.
7Na okoo ne wɔn bɛbom ahwehwe fam,
ɛne anantwie ne anantwinini akɛseɛ,
na wɔn asase bɛboro mogya,
na sradeɛ ayɛ wɔn dɔteɛ sɔɔsɔɔ.
8 # Yes 13.6, 9; 63.4 Na AWURADE wɔ aweretɔ da
ne ananmuhyɛ afe a ɔbɛdi ama Sion.
9 # Gye 19.24 Na Edom nsuwansuwa bɛdane aman,
na ne dɔteɛ nso adane sɔfe,
na n’asase no ayɛ aman a ɛdɛreɛ;
10 # Adi 14.11; 19.3 ɛrennum anadwo ne awia,
ne wisie bɛpunu akɔsi daa,
na ayɛ amamfo, awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu,
na obiara remfa hɔ bio koraa;
11na akorɔma ne kɔtɔkɔ na wɔbɛfa,
na patuo ne anene atena hɔ.
Na ɔbɛsa so sakasakayɛ homa,
na amamfoyɛ sumpii boɔ asɛne so.
12Na wɔbɛfrɛ hɔ sɛ, Ahennie Biara Nni Hɔ,
na n’asafohene nyinaa bɛyera.
13 # Yes 13.21-22 Nkasɛɛ bɛfu n’aban afɛfɛ mu,
na nsansono ne hwerɛmo afu n’abandenden mu,
na ayɛ ɛserɛ so kraman tenabea
ne nsohori adidibea.
14 # Adi 18.2 Na ɛserɛ so mmoa ne nkuntumpaa bɛhyia hɔ,
na sasabonsam asu afrɛ ne mfɛfoɔ;
ɛhɔ nso na anadwoboa bɛtena,
na wanya ɔhome.
15Ɛhɔ na ɔpatuo bɛyɛ ne buo,
na wato abutu so ahwane, na waboaboa ne mma ano wɔ ne nwunu mu,
na asansa nso aboaboa wɔn ano wɔ hɔ,
obiara ne n’atipɛnsoɔ.
16Monhwehwɛ AWURADE nwoma no mu nkenkan:
Yeinom mu baako mpo renyera,
ebi tiafoɔ remmɔ no, na AWURADE
ano na ahyɛ, na ne honhom na aboa ano.
17Na ɔno na watwe tonto de ama wɔn,
na ne nsa de susuhoma akyɛ ama wɔn,
sɛ wɔnni so nkɔsi daa, na wɔntena so, awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.

Amanaman, montwe mpini mmɛtie,
na mo, nkurɔfoɔ, monwɛn mo aso.
Asase ne ne mayɛ ntie,
wiase ne deɛ ɛfiri mu ba nyinaa.
Na AWURADE abohuro bɛba amanaman nyinaa so,
na abufuhyeɛ aba wɔn dɔm nyinaa so,
wadome wɔn de wɔn ama okum.
Na wɔn atɔfoɔ no, wɔbɛto wɔn agu,
na wɔn afunu ayi hwa kankan,
na wɔn mogya atene wɔ mmepɔ so.

anaasɛ borɔdɔma so deɛ poɔ no.
Na m’afena anom amee wɔ soro;
hwɛ, ɛsiane ba Edom so,
ɛreba me nnome man no so abɛbu atɛn.
Mogya ara nko adue AWURADE afena,
sradeɛ afɔre ho,
nnwammaa ne mpapo mogya,
adwennini sawa ho sradeɛ,
na AWURADE wɔ okum afɔdeɛ wɔ Bosra ne okunkɛseɛ wɔ Edom asase so.
Na okoo ne wɔn bɛbom ahwehwe fam,
ɛne anantwie ne anantwinini akɛseɛ,
na wɔn asase bɛboro mogya,
na sradeɛ ayɛ wɔn dɔteɛ sɔɔsɔɔ.
Na AWURADE wɔ aweretɔ da
ne ananmuhyɛ afe a ɔbɛdi ama Sion.
Na Edom nsuwansuwa bɛdane aman,
na ne dɔteɛ nso adane sɔfe,
na n’asase no ayɛ aman a ɛdɛreɛ;
ɛrennum anadwo ne awia,

Na ɔbɛsa so sakasakayɛ homa,

Na wɔbɛfrɛ hɔ sɛ, Ahennie Biara Nni Hɔ,

Nkasɛɛ bɛfu n’aban afɛfɛ mu,

ne nsohori adidibea.
Na ɛserɛ so mmoa ne nkuntumpaa bɛhyia hɔ,
na sasabonsam asu afrɛ ne mfɛfoɔ;
ɛhɔ nso na anadwoboa bɛtena,

Ɛhɔ na ɔpatuo bɛyɛ ne buo,
na wato abutu so ahwane, na waboaboa ne mma ano wɔ ne nwunu mu,
na asansa nso aboaboa wɔn ano wɔ hɔ,
obiara ne n’atipɛnsoɔ.
Monhwehwɛ AWURADE nwoma no mu nkenkan:
Yeinom mu baako mpo renyera,
ebi tiafoɔ remmɔ no, na AWURADE
ano na ahyɛ, na ne honhom na aboa ano.
Na ɔno na watwe tonto de ama wɔn,

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
